brief_title: A Clinical Study Testing Enicepatide in Participants Living With Overweight or Obesity and Cardiovascular Disease
official_title: A Phase III, Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-controlled, Trial to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Enicepatide in Participants With Overweight or Obesity and Cardiovascular Disease

primary_outcomes.measure: Time to First Occurrence of Any Component of 5-point (5P) MACE

brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the efficacy and safety of enicepatide, a dual glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1)/glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide (GIP) receptor agonist (RA), as a therapy to reduce the risk of major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE) in adults living with overweight or obesity and established cardiovascular disease (CVD), with or without type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM).

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Body Mass Index (BMI) ≥25.0 kilograms per meter square (kg/m2)
* Have established and stable cardiovascular disease (CVD)
* Participants should be treated with stable (per investigator judgment) background therapy for CVD, such as hyperlipidemia and T2DM (if relevant), as per local and international guidelines, excluding use of GLP-1 RA-based therapies
* For participants with T2DM: HbA1c ≤10% based on central laboratory assessment at Screening

Exclusion Criteria:

* History of type 1 diabetes mellitus, or any lifetime history of ketoacidosis or hyperosmolar state/coma within 12 months prior to Screening
* Any serious medical condition or abnormality in clinical laboratory tests that precludes an individual's safe participation in and completion of the study per investigator judgment
* Any preplanned major medical procedure or surgery at the time of Screening including planning to have a surgical, endoscopic, or device treatment for obesity
* Known clinically significant gastric emptying abnormality (e.g., severe gastroparesis or gastric outlet obstruction)
* Chronic dialysis (e.g., chronic hemodialysis, chronic peritoneal dialysis)
